title: A changed store backup hashes the settled copy twice before upload
outcome: A changed store backup hashes the settled copy twice before upload
acceptance: When a store push has a newest receipt and different settled bytes, comparison and full verification read/hash the staged file once; the full check still validates the same staged bytes and retains interruption/error handling. A regression demonstrates the one-hash path and equal-copy reuse.

completion.summary: Changed backup capture reads and hashes its private settled stage once; full immutable verification reuses only that stage's digest and retains every other check. Exact hashing regression and uploaded-byte correspondence pass.
